description.zh: 用嵌入包的 tio 打开串口终端：在搜索框里就地设置端口、波特率、数据位、校验、停止位和流控，Enter 启动、再 Enter 停止；也可开独立窗口配置。终端由 Windows Terminal 或 conhost 提供，插件本身不读取、不显示、不记录任何串口内容。
description.en: Open a serial terminal with the bundled tio: set the port, baud rate, data bits, parity, stop bits and flow control in place in the search box, Enter starts and Enter again stops, or configure in a standalone window. Windows Terminal or conhost provides the terminal; the plugin never reads, renders or logs serial content.

hint.zh: Enter 启动，再 Enter 停止；参数行 Enter 就地修改
hint.en: Enter starts, Enter again stops; Enter on a parameter edits it in place

ai.description: Configure and launch the bundled tio serial terminal. Rows show the port (COMn and its /dev/ttyS(n-1) mapping), baud rate, data bits, parity, stop bits, flow control and the terminal backend (Windows Terminal first, conhost as the fallback). Enter on the launch row starts tio after six pre-launch checks; Enter again stops the session this plugin started. Parameter rows edit in place. A started process is not a connected port: the plugin never reads serial data and never claims the port is open.

hint.zh: COMn，映射到 /dev/ttyS(n-1)；留空用本机第一个端口。在搜索框或窗口里改过之后以那里为准
hint.en: COMn, mapped to /dev/ttyS(n-1); empty uses the machine's first port. Once changed in the search box or the window, that wins

hint.zh: tio 3.9 支持的正整数，默认 115200
hint.en: A positive rate tio 3.9 supports, default 115200

hint.zh: hard 时 RTS 由流控管理，不承诺固定电平
hint.en: with hard flow the RTS follows the flow, not a fixed level

hint.zh: auto 优先 wt.exe，没有则 conhost；选了这台机器没有的后端会被忽略
hint.en: auto prefers wt.exe and falls back to conhost; a backend this machine lacks is ignored
